Flight demonstration of the SC-OBC module.
Description

Two SC-OBC Module A1s will be installed on the 3U Cubesat "SC-Sat1". Through the long-term operation of SC-Sat1, the fault tolerance performance of the SC-OBC Module A1 in outer space will be demonstrated.
